## Facts

- 7 kinds are not awaitable with `events.wait` (no EventMatch): `workspace_metadata_updated`, `workspace_reordered`, `worktree_created`, `worktree_opened`, `worktree_removed`, `pane_updated`, `layout_updated`.
- `pane_output_changed` has no subscription type and is reachable only through `events.wait`.
- `pane.output_matched`, `pane.scroll_changed` have no EventKind; they carry the parameterised subscription frame.
- `pane_agent_status_changed` is in both shapes: the lifecycle EventFrame and the SubscriptionEventFrame.
